description: Phase 4B exploratory scripted pacing observation. Historical stress profiles and a bounded visible-decision bot, not human play, a balance threshold or full HTTP/session validation.

profiles.seeded_coach: Equal 70-rated rosters; alternate inside_run/slant; punt/field goal on fourth; no penalties, injuries, timeouts, overtime.
profiles.scripted_physics: Actual fixed-tick physics recordings at actual LOS; two defenders; same intended 50/50 run/pass mix. Run straight with small initial lateral input and a tick38 juke. Pass at tick55 to alternating receiver plus four yards x, no z lead. Historical stress: seed+call index, LB1/S1, no on-field participant fatigue.
profiles.scripted_early_lead: Same physics run profile. Pass at tick30 to receiver with largest projected distance from defenders, 0.7s velocity lead in x and z. Historical sensitivity: seed+call index, LB1/S1, no on-field participant fatigue.
profiles.seeded_coach_decisions: Same down/distance call-selection policy as visible decisions: pass probability25% at<=3yd,80% on third/longer,55% otherwise; deterministic separate call hash. Coach uses its unchanged outcome model and actual Coach participants.
profiles.scripted_visible_decisions: Current official slants only; official per-play LivePlaySeed, pass CB1/CB2 or run LB1/CB1, actual on-field identity/role fatigue metadata. Visible route and nominal flight-time leading; read every0.2s from0.8 to2.4s; projected receiver separation2.5yd and descending-lane clearance2yd; no safe window -> scramble. Defender extrapolation capped0.35s. No hidden RNG, future states or trial throws. Same down/distance call-selection policy as seeded_coach_decisions; both punt/FG on fourth.

limitations: Not human input or full eleven-on-eleven balance. Arcade has two CPU defenders, while Coach resolves its full rules/outcome model; reduced-field breakaways are not evidence of a clock defect.
Only slants are currently selectable in official exhibition sessions. Comeback comparisons belong to the separate drill/sensitivity matrix, not these full-game rows.
Physics outputs go directly to shared accounting/finalization; HTTP persistence, authorization, result validation and concurrency are tested separately.

This is not the complete official service pipeline: the accounting fixture retains the slant call label rather than short_pass and does not execute HurryUp::prepare or the live-result contract. Actual actor fatigue metadata is included, but full session and hurry-up personnel protocols require separate integration coverage.

Primary visible-decision profile includes actual on-field player identity/role metadata for fatigue; presentation and replay tracks are omitted. Historical stress/early-lead profiles retain empty participants and old seed/role choices to preserve prior observations.
No penalties, injuries, timeouts or overtime; fourth-down punts/field goals and other special teams use Coach, never a second outcome for a live interactive play.

runs and passes count selected play calls. actual_pass_attempts counts throw events; scrambles counts unthrown live runs. Coach actual_pass_attempts/scrambles are null because these are not reconstructed from its different outcome classification.
Counts are offensive run/pass snaps and offensive possessions, including partial final possession; snaps_per_drive is offensive snaps/possession.

The visible bot has exact route geometry and a bounded nominal trajectory heuristic, not human aiming error or learned human decision timings. Its conditional completion rate is not a human completion prediction.
The same strategy rules do not create matched outcomes/call sequences after games diverge. Matched-outcome clock/accounting equivalence is covered by separate characterization tests.
No balance acceptance threshold is inferred. Pacing remains a review gate pending hands-on feedback.
normal_120_conclusion: Early benchmark interception and incompletion rates are highly input-sensitive. Visible decisions improve passing but do not establish comparable full-game pace: two-defender breakaways and scores can still produce short drives. Preserve clock rules and .925 speed pending human feedback.

provenance.working_tree: Isolated cloud feature/arcade-gameplay investigation; source hashes identify measured inputs.
provenance.report_source: Final aligned focused PHP suite: 40 passed, 1192 assertions; 183 unique benchmark rows. Full-suite verification is recorded separately on issue #4.
